comment: T-021 cold indoors on GENERATED maps (designer 2026-11-19): read by UColdShelterSubsystem with the map's levelgen layout; pure rule Survival/ColdShelterRules, tests CodexTactics.Survival.ColdShelter.*. A building's leak = the weight of its open (broken / kicked out / open / breached) openings / the weight of all its openings; an intact closed door or glazed window is sealed. The generator writes no opening states: a doorway gap with NO door leaf (a door with no state) starts OPEN with a draught (designer 2026-11-19), a stateless window starts sealed (glazed) until a runtime glass / boarded state exists; runtime changes arrive through UColdShelterSubsystem::SetOpeningOpen. The building's base cold multiplier = leak * leak_to_cold (all sealed 0, a fully open building 1 = open air); within draught_full_m of an OPEN opening on the SAME storey the multiplier is 1, falling linearly to the base at draught_fade_m; indoors = max(base, strongest draught). A camera zone, when one holds the operative, still wins (hand-made maps unchanged). A missing key keeps the code default. Distances in metres here (cm in code), weights are relative.

weights._comment: Share of one opening in the leak. door 3, window 1, wall breach 4 (designer 2026-11-19); a roof hole counts as a breach; a loophole (a 20-40 cm slit) is a half window.

_comment_leak_to_cold: Base multiplier = leak * this. 1.0: a fully open building is as cold as open air, a sealed one has no accumulation (and warms, as a Closed camera zone does).
_comment_draught_full_m: Designer: it is cold within 3-4 m of a kicked-out door. Same storey only; the multiplier is 1 (outdoor) inside this radius of an open opening.
_comment_draught_fade_m: The draught has fallen to the building's base multiplier at this distance (linear between draught_full_m and here).
_comment_roof_margin_cm: The feet must be this far below the roof slab to count as inside (on the roof they stand on the slab).
_comment_ground_margin_cm: The feet may be this far below the layout's ground and still count as inside (a sunken threshold).
_comment_storey_tolerance_cm: Feet this far below the next slab count as already on that storey (ramps, stairs) for the same-storey draught.
